events.verdict: Jones Jr. (LAC) legally contests Durant's (PHX) jump shot attempt.

Booker (PHX) has his left arm extended across Harden's (LAC) body and initiates contact with Harden's left arm, which affects Harden's ability to cleanly gather. The illegal contact occurs prior to Harden's upward shooting motion and a non-shooting foul is correctly assessed.
Beal (PHX) makes contact with Harden's (LAC) arm prior to the release, which affects his jump shot attempt.
Durant (PHX) swings the ball from side-to-side and marginal contact occurs with his wrist as Jones Jr. (LAC) reaches for the ball.
Jones Jr. (LAC) legally contests Durant's (PHX) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Plumlee (PHX) holds down Zubac's (LAC) shoulder, initiating illegal contact during the dunk attempt.
Plumlee (PHX) goes through Coffey (LAC), who establishes himself in a legal guarding position in Plumlee's path prior to his upward motion on the pass attempt.
Booker (PHX) maintains a legal guarding position and incidental contact occurs as he defends Harden (LAC) during the drive.
Plumlee (PHX) legally contests Powell's (LAC) driving shot attempt.

Replay review of the foul called on Harden (LAC) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Harden is moving laterally into Beal's (PHX) path and initiates contact with Beal's right leg as he elevates, which affects Beal's driving shot attempt.
Booker (PHX) briefly grasps Powell's (LAC) right arm and marginal contact occurs as Powell disengages to slip the pick.
Booker (PHX) initiates illegal contact with Powell's (LAC) left arm prior to his upward shooting motion and a non-shooting foul is correctly assessed.
Jones Jr.'s (LAC) right arm brushes Beal's (PHX) right arm and marginal contact occurs before Beal makes his intended pass.
Harden (LAC) commits a take foul on Allen (PHX).
Beal (PHX) extends his arm toward the ball and marginal contact occurs with Harden's (LAC) arm before Harden temporarily loses control of the ball by dribbling it off his own leg.
Beal (PHX) maintains a legal guarding position and absorbs the incidental contact from Harden (LAC) as he turns and jumps toward the basket on the jump shot attempt.
Coffey (LAC) commits a take foul on Allen (PHX).
Plumlee (PHX) avoids making any contact with Powell (LAC) during the last-second shot attempt.
